roles.title: Marketing & Business Development Executive
roles.summary: Find business opportunities, generate leads, communicate with prospective clients, and support client acquisition.
responsibilities: Research target companies, prospects, and new business opportunities.
Generate and qualify leads through LinkedIn, email, networking, and other channels.
Connect with prospects and maintain regular follow-ups.
Understand client requirements and coordinate with the internal team.
Maintain lead records and track ongoing opportunities.
Support proposals, presentations, and other business development activities.
Use AI tools effectively for research, prospecting, analysis, communication, and day-to-day work.
requirements: 0–1 year of experience; freshers can apply.
Smart, presentable, and comfortable taking initiative.
Strong willingness to learn and improve.
Ability to think independently rather than simply follow instructions.
Comfortable using or learning AI tools to make work more efficient and effective.
niceToHave: Prior internship in sales, marketing, or business development.
Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar prospecting tools.
Basic understanding of B2B / IT services.
benefits: Direct exposure to global clients and enterprise projects.
Fast growth path — take real ownership from day one.
AI-first workflow — the whole team uses modern AI tools daily.

roles.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Executive
roles.summary: Build the company's digital presence, plan relevant content, manage social platforms, and improve brand visibility.
responsibilities: Manage the company's presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Plan content calendars based on business goals, audience interests, and platform requirements.
Research industry topics, trends, competitors, and content opportunities.
Develop and coordinate posts, carousels, videos, reels, articles, and other formats.
Monitor reach, engagement, audience growth, and content performance.
Maintain consistency in the company's communication and brand presence.
Use AI tools for research, content ideas, analysis, optimisation, and improving work efficiency.
requirements: 0–1 year of experience; freshers can apply.
Smart, presentable, and comfortable taking initiative.
Strong willingness to learn and improve.
Ability to think independently rather than simply follow instructions.
Comfortable using or learning AI tools to make work more efficient and effective.
niceToHave: Personal or portfolio work on Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube.
Basic experience with Canva, Figma, CapCut, or similar creative tools.
Prior internship in a digital marketing agency or in-house content team.
benefits: Own the brand's voice across every platform from day one.
Direct visibility of your work — 130+ platforms shipped, real case studies to promote.
AI-first workflow — the whole team uses modern AI tools daily.
